subject: Deletion request — prompts/outputs/logs: scope Q&A and confirmation
messages:
From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@datacorp.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-09T17:22:00-04:00
Subject: Deletion request — prompts/outputs/logs for workspace acme-eu-prod

Hi Alex,

Per our data retention policy alignment, we'd like Redwood to execute a deletion sweep for the workspace 'acme-eu-prod' (customer id: DTA-ACME-09). Scope: all prompt inputs, assistant outputs, and inference logs (including request metadata and KV-cache derivatives) generated before 2024-12-01.

Please confirm:
- Whether the erase will include KV cache artifacts and ephemeral model-state files
- Expected timeline and evidence artifacts you can provide (runbook, manifest, signed timestamp)
- Any impacts to ongoing inference for the workspace or required downtime

Legal is cc'd on this note; we need a retention certificate for our records.

Thanks,
Elena Vargas
Head of Platform Operations
DataCorp Analytics

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@datacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-09T18:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Deletion request — prompts/outputs/logs for workspace acme-eu-prod

Thanks Elena — we can handle this. A couple quick clarifying questions before we schedule the sweep: 

1) Do you want deletions limited to the primary workspace (acme-eu-prod), or should we include any snapshot clones and test sandboxes that reference the same workspace id?
2) For "logs", do you mean both raw request/response logs and any derived telemetry we keep for batching/latency analysis?
3) Would you prefer a rolling purge (per-day batches over a week) or a single-run sweep?

Marissa (Ops) and Marcus (Serving Runtime) are looped in to confirm technical approach and evidence package. Once I have answers I'll share a proposed timeline and the runbook we will execute.

- Alex
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@datacorp.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-10T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Deletion request — proposed plan and artifacts

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear scope. Answering Alex's items and proposing an ops plan: 

- Scope confirmation: We will delete: prompt inputs, assistant outputs, request logs (raw payloads), inference metadata (timestamps, latency metrics), and KV-cache derivatives tied to workspace id "acme-eu-prod". We will NOT touch model binaries, shared prefetch caches, or telemetry aggregated at org-level. Snapshots/clones: please confirm whether those are in scope — if they reference the same workspace id they are included by default; if not, we'll need explicit list of clone ids.

- Technical approach:
  * Step 1 — Identify all keys/objects by workspace id across service tables and S3 prefix.
  * Step 2 — Schedule non-disruptive deletion job (no downtime expected for read-only inference; write-heavy operations will be throttled).
  * Step 3 — Run KV-cache invalidation and background garbage-collection for cache shards.
  * Step 4 — Produce manifest and signed timestamped sweep report.

- Timeline (proposed):
  * Start: 2025-04-14 02:00 UTC (low traffic window)
  * Duration: 4–8 hours depending on clone count; we'll provide status updates at start, mid-run, and completion.

Attached runbook and a sample manifest format for your review: (attachments)
  - erasure_manifest_20250410.csv (sample manifest schema)
  - ops_wipe_runbook.pdf (procedure and rollback controls)

Please confirm if snapshots/clones should be included and whether you want a single sweep or a rolling purge. If Legal requires signed notarized evidence, note that separately and we'll route through Compliance.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Customer Ops (Erase & Compliance)
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs: erasure_manifest_20250410.csv (text/csv), ops_wipe_runbook.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@datacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: DataCorp Legal <legal@datacorp.com>
Date: 2025-04-10T10:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Deletion request — proposed plan and artifacts

Thanks Marissa — include clones and snapshots that reference the same workspace id. We do not need any unrelated test sandboxes. Single-run sweep preferred (faster for our audit timeline).

Legal note: we need a timestamped, signed sweep report and a manifest listing S3 prefixes and object counts. Notarization not required, but please include a PGP-signed checksum or similar.

Please proceed with the proposed start window on 2025-04-14.

Elena

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@datacorp.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-04-10T14:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Deletion request — execution confirmation and evidence delivery

Elena — confirming execution plan and evidence package. Per your confirmation we will include all snapshots/clones referencing workspace id "acme-eu-prod". Key points: 

- Job id: erasure-5571 (ops console) — monitoring link: https://redwood.app/ops/jobs/erasure-5571
- Start: 2025-04-14T02:00:00Z
- Expected completion: same day (4–8 hours)
- Evidence we will deliver post-run:
  1) sweep_report_acme_20250410.tar (contains run logs, signed manifest, and checksums)
  2) s3_paths.txt (list of S3 prefixes and object counts removed)
  3) erasure_manifest_20250410.csv (canonical manifest with object ids)

We've attached the final runbook and sample manifest for your records. Marcus has validated KV-cache invalidation strategy and confirmed no shared-model artifacts will be removed.

If Legal wants a PGP-signed checksum, we'll include one in the sweep_report (sha256 + signature). Please reply if you require any change to the scope.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment stubs: sweep_report_acme_20250410.tar (application/x-tar), s3_paths.txt (text/plain), erasure_manifest_20250410.csv (text/csv)
